results.title: Eden Sher: I Was On A Sitcom
results.original_title: Eden Sher: I Was On A Sitcom
results.overview: Riotous and deeply personal, Eden Sher’s debut comedy special is a show about finding out who you are when your TV show ends and your "real life" begins. Because when you've played a character on TV for a decade, what exactly does it mean to "be yourself?” Living at the intersection of stand-up, storytelling and theatrical chaos, this solo show offers a rare intimate glimpse inside a popular sitcom actor’s real, raw life. Sher dives headfirst into the identity crisis that followed nine years of playing the same character—and what happens when a nurse recognizes you while in the middle of your emergency C-section.  Whether you're a die-hard Middle fan or have no idea who Eden Sher is (she will explain), I Was On A Sitcom is a wild, hilarious, and oddly moving ride through fame, identity, and a harrowing surprise twin pregnancy.

results.title: The Building is Not Empty
results.overview: While exploring a historic warehouse in Belfast, a present-day film crew begins to encounter fragments of the building’s past, revealing the lives and stories that once occupied its rooms across different periods of history.

results.title: The Resident
results.overview: A caregiver trainee accidentally mentions a wealthy patient in a mansion to her boyfriend in debt. He and a friend plan to rob the place, but discover things aren't what they seem once inside.

results.title: TransParent Love
results.overview: In a country where being transgender still carries risk, Mexican mothers and their children embark on an intimate journey toward understanding. Amid silences, memories, and words that once caused pain, they recount their process of mutual transformation—from fear to chosen love. This documentary reveals that love can be learned, that it can defy fear, and that even in hostile environments, accompaniment becomes an act of resistance.

results.title: Riccardo Chailly & Lukas Sternath @ Lucerne Festival 2026 (complete version)
results.original_title: Riccardo Chailly & Lukas Sternath Festival de Lucerne 2026 (version intégrale)
results.overview: Since the summer of 2019, the Lucerne Festival Orchestra and Riccardo Chailly have been taking audiences on a journey through Sergei Rachmaninoff’s symphonic and concertante world, featuring both essential works and rarities, such as his early opera "Aleko".  But before you discover the magic of his music, let yourself be carried away by his Piano Concerto No. 4, performed by the young pianist Lukas Sternath.

results.title: Brad Williams: Live on Short Street
results.original_title: Brad Williams: Live on Short Street
results.overview: Brad Williams is back with his fourth stand-up comedy special LIVE ON SHORT STREET!  A fearless, high-energy hour packed with outrageous true stories, brutally honest observations, and nonstop laughs from one of the most electrifying comedians in the world.  Filmed live in front of a sold-out crowd in Lexington, KY, Brad dives into everything from relationships, marriage, and fatherhood to disability, sex, therapy, and the absurd realities of modern life. With razor-sharp punchlines and explosive storytelling, this special proves why Brad continues to sell out theaters around the globe.

results.title: The Blueberry Blues
results.overview: Summer unveils a new blueberry season in northern Canada. The fields are covered in blue and workers from all over scramble before the frost puts an end to the harvest. And yet this time of year is much more than just picking: it's a time of music and connection.
